svg.title: Jing-Zhang City Completeness Brand and VI Concept Direction
svg.desc: C7 City Completeness core symbol, naming hierarchy, seven-capability icon grammar, bilingual communication, and event/IP extension rules.
svg.text: Jing-Zhang City Completeness v0.5 | Brand / VI Concept Direction
Positioning: not an “AI-tech skin” for the city, but a recognizable language for ordinary city capabilities plus opt-out AI.
Core symbol direction: C7 COMPLETE LOOP
C7
“Open loop” = the city keeps becoming more complete
Twin rails reference the Jing-Zhang linear memory; seven nodes reference C7. This concept must not imitate an official seal, government emblem, approval stamp, or event organizer identity.
Naming and communication hierarchy
京张城市完整度
JING-ZHANG CITY COMPLETENESS
Proposition: 先把城市做完整，再让 AI 进入日常。
English proposition: Complete the city first, then let AI enter daily life.
Secondary identity: C7 capability tags + three key-area roles
ZHONGZHIYUAN — complete innovation campus
AI ORIGIN COMMUNITY — complete long-term community
DAZHONGSI — complete station-city life district
“Shuangfen Fortress Community” remains a local naming easter egg only: no city-level master-brand role, castle morphology, walling, or enclosure grammar.
C7 icon grammar: text first, icon second; color is never the only information channel
Event / IP extensions (concept names)
City Completeness Week｜城市完整度开放周
annual public C7 audit, gap release, public questions, next-iteration action list
Open Test Yard｜开放测试场
controlled Zhongzhiyuan tests with teach-back and safety review
City Commons Hall + Jing-Zhang Civic Station
civic living room and honor nodes: real public function first, communication second
VI use rules
1. Chinese and English have equal rank; English is not decorative microcopy.
2. Every scenario visual carries both a C7 capability tag and “AI opt-out” state.
3. Official-boundary/approval status stays visually separate from brand communication.
4. No government emblems, official stamps, unauthorized logos, or “implemented” claims.
5. Icons always pair text/shape redundancy so color-vision differences do not block meaning.
Final identity requires real copyright, trademark, font, and event-branding review.
Original concept VI for this submission only; not the official identity of the open call, Haidian District, or any government/institution.
